children: GitLab Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $286.25M, up 21.3% from $235.96M a year earlier, and a net loss of ($36.84M) versus a loss of ($9.21M) in the prior-year quarter. Diluted EPS was ($0.22) compared with ($0.06) a year ago.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to GitLab”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by new customers, expansion within the base, and an increase in accounts with more than $100K ARR.
Shift toward SaaS and Flex purchasing increased hosting costs and weighed on gross margin as SaaS growth outpaced self-managed.
Customer metrics remained strong: base customers grew 8%, $100K ARR accounts rose 17%, and dollar-based net retention was 117% (down from 121%).

Operational investments continued with higher R&D and sales & marketing headcount and sustained monthly releases (178 consecutive months), supporting product momentum and adoption among large enterprises.
Brand scale includes more than 50 million registered users and roughly half of the Fortune 100 as customers.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
